description: Set a 3D layer's Material Options: casts shadows (off, on, only), light transmission, accepts shadows (off, on, only: a shadow catcher), accepts lights, ambient, diffuse, specular intensity and shininess, metal, appears in reflections, reflection intensity, sharpness and rolloff, transparency and its rolloff, and index of refraction. Also turns a layer into an environment layer (Layer > Environment Layer). Values are keyframed when the property is animated or a time is given

acceptsLights.description: Accepts Lights: off leaves the layer unlit

acceptsShadows.description: Accepts Shadows: off, on, or only (shadows alone, for a shadow catcher)

appearsInReflections.description: Appears in Reflections: off, on, or only

castsShadows.description: Casts Shadows: off, on, or only (the shadow without the layer)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

environmentLayer.description: Layer > Environment Layer: use this footage or precomposition layer as the spherical environment for reflections (Cinema 4D renderer; Advanced 3D uses environment lights instead)

layers.description: Which 3D layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time. Omit to set the static value, or a keyframe at the current time when the property is already animated

name: set_material_options
title: Set Material Options
